column1: # The tables whose callout and registered-model-validator surface the Phase 5g
# write increments must be able to attribute. This is a REVIEWED input, not a
# generated one: it states which tables the attribution claim covers.
# C_BPartner is the 5g-1a fixture table. The other three are carried so that the
# attribution analyzer is exercised against tables that DO have hooks. A gate
# whose only scope row is the table it claims has zero hooks cannot distinguish
# "correctly found nothing" from "found nothing because it looks nowhere".
# C_BPartner_Location is in scope for attribution but is EXCLUDED from the 5g-1a
# capture flow; see exclusions.tsv. Scope and flow are different questions.
